description: React component implementing a guardrail testing panel, including input handling, copy to clipboard, and displaying test results.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles submitting the input text for guardrail testing.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyDown events in the textarea, submits on Enter key without modifiers.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies given text to the clipboard, using secure APIs or fallback method.

methods.name: handleCopyInput
methods.description: Handles copying the input text to the clipboard and notifying the user.
